name: exalted2e
description: Exalted Second Edition — Foundry VTT system.

scripts.pack: npm run pack:charms && npm run pack:hearthstones && npm run pack:macros && npm run pack:martialarts && npm run pack:npcs && npm run pack:panoply && npm run pack:paradox-bites && npm run pack:spells && npm run pack:thaumaturgy  && npm run pack:resplendencies  && npm run pack:manse
scripts.pack:charms: fvtt package pack -n charms --in src/packs/charms --out packs
scripts.pack:hearthstones: fvtt package pack -n hearthstones --in src/packs/hearthstones --out packs
scripts.pack:macros: fvtt package pack -n macros --in src/packs/macros --out packs
scripts.pack:martialarts: fvtt package pack -n martialarts --in src/packs/martialarts --out packs
scripts.pack:npcs: fvtt package pack -n npcs --in src/packs/actors --out packs
scripts.pack:panoply: fvtt package pack -n panoply --in src/packs/panoply --out packs
scripts.pack:paradox-bites: fvtt package pack -n paradox-bites --in src/packs/paradox-bites --out packs
scripts.pack:spells: fvtt package pack -n spells --in src/packs/spells --out packs
scripts.pack:thaumaturgy: fvtt package pack -n thaumaturgy --in src/packs/thaumaturgy --out packs
scripts.pack:resplendencies: fvtt package pack -n resplendencies --in src/packs/resplendencies --out packs
scripts.pack:manse: fvtt package pack -n manse-powers --in src/packs/manse-powers --out packs
